nodes.name: Load config
nodes.notes: Runtime config lives in one Supabase row, not in n8n env vars. This n8n instance blocks $env access in nodes (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE), so $env.PUBLIC_BASE_URL silently resolved to an error string and every drain call failed. The Supabase credential is the only secret, and it lives in n8n's encrypted credential store where a secret belongs.

nodes.name: Call drain
nodes.notes: A non-2xx here throws, which marks the execution failed and lets the error workflow alert. Rotating the drain secret is one UPDATE on app_config plus the matching Vercel env var — no workflow edit.
